first_usable_pose_latency_ms.definition: Cold-start latency from the live run request, before selected estimator/session initialization, until the first usable pose is delivered to the app. ARKit uses callback delivery of its first normal-tracking pose; Basalt/XRSLAM use publication of the first finite pose emitted after estimator initialization. Gated relative to the ARKit reference measured on the same device and recording: a candidate fails only if its latency exceeds the reference's. Production's 1800 ms (ar_capture_page.dart _warmupFallbackDuration) is a UI warm-up fallback that opens the page regardless of tracking state, not a tracking requirement, and ARKit itself measures about 2.9 s to normal tracking here; an absolute 1800 ms gate therefore failed the reference it was meant to compare against and was removed on 2026-09-03.

measurement_duration_seconds.definition: Actual scored wall duration from the live run request before selected estimator/session initialization; normally the full 300-second product session with no excluded warm-up, and shorter only for an explicitly receipted safety stop.

processed_fps.definition: Finite pose outputs for the selected arm divided by the declared measurement interval.

p95_pipeline_latency_ms.definition: For Basalt/XRSLAM, nearest-rank P95 from capture timestamp to finite pose publication. For ARKit, ARFrame.timestamp to delegate-entry delta under the documented same-clock assumption; the latter is a proxy, not hardware latency ground truth.

app_drop_rate.definition: For Basalt/XRSLAM, bounded-application camera drops divided by offered camera inputs. For ARKit, timestamp-gap-estimated missing frames divided by observed plus estimated frames; ARKit does not expose platform drop ground truth.

thermal_critical_seconds.definition: Measurement-interval wall time while ProcessInfo thermalState was critical.

thermal_serious_seconds.definition: Measurement-interval wall time while ProcessInfo thermalState was serious.

peak_phys_footprint_mb.definition: Maximum task physical footprint sampled during the measurement interval, divided by 1048576.

finite_pose_ratio.definition: Finite SE(3) pose outputs divided by all pose outputs emitted during measurement.

battery_level_delta.definition: UIDevice battery-level change over measurement; a coarse proxy that is not converted to watts.

cpu_seconds.definition: Process user plus system CPU-time delta over the declared measurement interval.

ate_rmse_m.definition: Translational absolute trajectory error RMSE after one SE(3) alignment with scale fixed to one.

rpe_translation_rmse_m.definition: Translation RMSE of relative pose error at a one-second horizon after the declared SE(3) alignment.

rpe_rotation_rmse_deg.definition: Rotation-angle RMSE of relative pose error at a one-second horizon after the declared SE(3) alignment.

ground_truth_coverage.definition: Fraction of eligible estimated poses matched to EuRoC ground truth by the frozen monotonic one-to-one nearest-neighbor association within 5 ms; equal-distance ties choose the earlier ground-truth timestamp.

tracking_normal_ratio.definition: ARKit frames reporting camera tracking state normal divided by all ARKit frames in measurement.

estimated_missed_frames.definition: ARKit-only estimate from ARFrame timestamp gaps and the selected nominal video format rate; not an exact platform drop count.

first_normal_latency_ms.definition: ARKit-only elapsed time from reference-session construction to the first normal tracking frame; -1 means unobserved.

first_mapped_latency_ms.definition: ARKit-only elapsed time to the first mapped worldMappingStatus; -1 means unobserved and is not an accuracy metric.

p95_callback_handler_duration_ms.definition: ARKit-only delegate-entry to delegate-return handler duration.

p95_frame_interval_ms.definition: ARKit-only P95 of positive consecutive ARFrame timestamp intervals.

max_frame_interval_ms.definition: ARKit-only maximum positive consecutive ARFrame timestamp interval.

stall_events_over_one_second.definition: ARKit-only count of consecutive ARFrame timestamp gaps greater than one second.

stall_duration_ms.definition: ARKit-only sum of full frame-gap durations for gaps greater than one second.

longest_non_normal_seconds.definition: ARKit-only longest observed contiguous interval outside normal tracking.

relocalization_attempts.definition: ARKit-only entries into limited/relocalizing; no custom relocalization policy is added.

relocalization_recoveries.definition: ARKit-only transitions from limited/relocalizing directly back to normal.

p95_consecutive_translation_m.definition: ARKit-only P95 translation change between consecutive finite world-from-camera poses; motion-dependent and not an accuracy error.

p95_consecutive_rotation_deg.definition: ARKit-only P95 rotation change between consecutive finite world-from-camera poses; motion-dependent and not an accuracy error.

power_w.definition: Calibrated electrical power. Public iOS APIs do not provide this measurement, so benchmark receipts must record null.
